title: Random-matrix reduction in projective quantum mechanics
summary: We develop a state-space geometric framework for measurement, classicality, and quantum paradoxes, based on one dynamical conjecture. Classical configuration space and classical phase space for a mechanical system arise as distinguished submanifolds of projective quantum state space. On these submanifolds, the Fubini--Study geometry induces Euclidean classical geometry, and the tangent component of Schrödinger evolution reproduces Newtonian dynamics. Within this framework, interactions with measuring devices and environments are described by random-matrix dynamics on projective state space,…
